# AIKloop Payments API

> AIKloop Payments (a fictional sandbox API used for a documentation demo) lets developers accept card payments, issue refunds and receive webhook events. The current version is v3. Versions v1 and v2 are deprecated: don't use /v1 or /v2 endpoints, query-string API keys, decimal amounts, a default currency, page/per_page pagination, or the X-AIKloop-Signature header with HMAC-SHA1. The Changelog has the full old-versus-new table.

Base URL: https://api.aikloop.example/v3
